item.title: A joke SCP about amnestics(Seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Before amnestics, the Foundation used other methods of erasing memories: hitting the subject in the head.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Joke SCP

Genre (Optional): Comedy

Elevator Pitch: A club classified as an SCP-J by the CKG Gathering due to its ability to erase memories if you swing it hard enough in the head.

Central Narrative: While on its search for methods to erase memories, the CKG Gathering discovers that hitting someone hard enough in the head with a club is able to erase memories. Therefore the club is classified as an anomalous "thing." The Foundation, of course, declares that the record is obsolete since they found a new method of erasing memories; hitting the head with an aluminium bat.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A photo of a club will be added for the readers to instantly notice what the "amnestic" is. Also, there will also be a parody of the amnestics guide page written in cavemen English. After this, I will add a modern revision of the object and will subvert the reader's expectation by revealing the Foundation simply decided to use other tools to bash heads, instead of using amnestics that we know.

Additional Notes: I want to know if there are other articles like this, or if it is better not to link it with SCP-001-EX-J.
